symptom: `alter page … { set ( visible: roles (A, B) ) on cntAdmin }` printed "Altered page", describe showed `Visible: [roles (A, B)]`, and mx check reported CE0117 "Error(s) in expression." at the container.
file: mdl/visitor/visitor_alter_page.go buildAlterSet; mdl/visitor/visible_roles_split.go splitVisibleRoles; mdl/backend/pagemutator/mutator.go setRawWidgetPropertyMut case visibleroles. Tests: mdl/visitor/alter_visible_roles_2371_test.go, mdl/backend/pagemutator/visible_roles_2371_test.go
cause: CREATE PAGE has a grammar alternative for `Visible: roles (…)` and #2319 split `roles (…) and <cond>`; the alter `set` path takes `visible:` as a widget expression, so the roles reached the mutator as VisibleIf text and were written as the visibility expression. The mutator had no case for module roles at all.
insight: **A fix to one statement's reading of a property is not a fix to the property.** #2319 fixed `Visible: roles` in CREATE; ALTER reads the same words through a different rule (alterPageAssignment → widget expression) and kept the old defect. When fixing a property spelling, grep every grammar rule that can carry it. Measured on 11.12.6: after the fix both `roles (A, B)` and `roles (A) and 2 = 2` describe back as roles (plus condition) and mx check reports 0 errors.
